newsitem.title: PERU: Peru truck crashes in jungle, kills 11, injures 17.
newsitem.headline: Peru truck crashes in jungle, kills 11, injures 17.

text.p: A cargo truck packed with passengers careened off a highway and overturned killing 11 people and injuring a further 17 in southern Peru's remote jungle hills, the Civil Defence said on Thursday.

Police reports blamed the accident, which did not involve another vehicle, on the driver, Civil Defence official Juan Alvarez told Reuters. The driver survived the accident and fled the scene, he added.

The truck was travelling near the town of Macusani in the department of Puno -- 800 miles (1,300 km) south of the capital Lima -- in an isolated zone where the lower slopes of the southern Andes merge into the jungle.
With few public transport vehicles in Peru's remote regions, trucks often pick up passengers after delivering their cargo.
